lines.zh: 我每走一步，地面都要先想一下。
lines.en: Each step I take, the ground thinks it over first.

lines.zh: 红色晶体压得我肩膀往下沉。
lines.en: Red crystal weighs my shoulders down.

lines.zh: 晶体的腿，一步一响。
lines.en: Crystal legs, one ringing step at a time.

lines.zh: 脚下的石块碎了，我照走不误。
lines.en: Stones crack underfoot; I keep walking.

lines.zh: 走得慢，是因为我太重，不是懒。
lines.en: I walk slowly because I am heavy, not lazy.

lines.zh: 我的腿像两截烧红的柱子。
lines.en: My legs are like two red-hot pillars.

lines.zh: 你们跑快没用，我一步顶三步。
lines.en: Your speed is useless; my step counts triple.

lines.zh: 地面在震，那是我在靠近。
lines.en: The ground shakes. That is me approaching.

lines.zh: 我踩过的裂缝，会留很久。
lines.en: The cracks I leave will stay a long while.

lines.zh: 每挪一步，我都要重新分配力气。
lines.en: Every step, I redistribute my strength.

lines.zh: 这具身体没有关节，只有支点。
lines.en: This body has no joints, only pivots.

lines.zh: 晶体踏在地上，咔咔响。
lines.en: My crystal limbs click on the ground.

lines.zh: 红晶磨着红晶，声音像闷雷。
lines.en: Red grinds red with a muffled thunder sound.

lines.zh: 你听见的震动，是我下一脚。
lines.en: The tremor you hear is my next footfall.

lines.zh: 我站着，就在给这片地加压。
lines.en: Standing here, I am pressing down on this land.

lines.zh: 力气攒着不用，会从缝里冒出来。
lines.en: Held-back strength leaks out through my seams.

lines.zh: 我数自己的重量，数到七十还在加。
lines.en: I count my weight and pass seventy, still rising.

lines.zh: 红色晶体在我胸口慢慢发烫。
lines.en: The red crystal in my chest slowly heats.

lines.zh: 我等一个人来试试我的力道。
lines.en: I wait for someone to test my force.

lines.zh: 静止的时候，我听见骨头在响。
lines.en: At rest, I hear my own frame creaking.

lines.zh: 这块石头挡住了我的视线。
lines.en: This boulder is in the way of my view.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，但我会叹气。
lines.en: I need no breath, yet I sigh.

lines.zh: 力量不吵闹，只在落下时说话。
lines.en: Strength is quiet and speaks only when it lands.

lines.zh: 我的拳头一直握着，松不开。
lines.en: My fists stay clenched; they will not open.

lines.zh: 四周的晶簇都比我矮一截。
lines.en: Every cluster around me stands a head shorter.

lines.zh: 我等着，等也是种发力。
lines.en: I wait, and waiting is a kind of effort.

lines.zh: 有东西在远处跑，跑不掉的。
lines.en: Something runs far off. It will not escape.

lines.zh: 我的影子压在地上，像块石头。
lines.en: My shadow lies on the ground like a stone.

lines.zh: 你比我想的还要小。
lines.en: You are even smaller than I expected.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，脖子有点僵。
lines.en: I look down at you; my neck is stiff.

lines.zh: 你站在那里，像根没拔的桩。
lines.en: You stand there like an unremoved post.

lines.zh: 我在算，要几下才能把你按平。
lines.en: I am counting how many hits flatten you.

lines.zh: 你的护甲很新，很快就旧了。
lines.en: Your armor is new. It will age quickly.

lines.zh: 别仰头太久，会累。
lines.en: Do not stare up too long; it tires the neck.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，手在找武器。
lines.en: As you look at me, your hand hunts for a weapon.

lines.zh: 我记住你的高度了，一米八。
lines.en: I have your height noted. One point eight.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我看见了。
lines.en: You took a step back. I saw it.

lines.zh: 我盯人不用眼睛，用重量。
lines.en: I do not stare with eyes but with weight.

lines.zh: 你站在我阴影里，别动。
lines.en: You stand in my shadow; stay still.

lines.zh: 晶体身体撞过来，声音很脆。
lines.en: My crystal body hits with a brittle crack.

lines.zh: 你这一下，连我的壳都没进。
lines.en: That blow did not even enter my shell.

lines.zh: 疼？我只是被推了一下。
lines.en: Pain? I was merely nudged.

lines.zh: 红晶掉了一角，我照样站着。
lines.en: A corner of red broke off; I still stand.

lines.zh: 你打得很准，可惜力气不够。
lines.en: You hit true, but without enough force.

lines.zh: 我的裂缝里全是压了多年的火。
lines.en: My cracks are full of fire pressed down for years.

lines.zh: 这一击让我更想碾碎你。
lines.en: That blow makes me want to grind you down.

lines.zh: 我的身体在响，是在准备。
lines.en: My body creaks. It is preparing.

lines.zh: 你听见碎裂声了吗，那是你的盾。
lines.en: Heard a crack? That was your shield.

lines.zh: 我不退，退一步要费很多力气。
lines.en: I do not retreat; stepping back costs too much.

lines.zh: 再来，让我看看你能多重。
lines.en: Again. Show me how heavy you can hit.

lines.zh: 你拿食物来，是想让我弯下腰？
lines.en: Food? You want me to bend down for it?

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只把东西压碎。
lines.en: I do not eat. I only crush things.

lines.zh: 红色晶体不需要喂。
lines.en: Red crystal does not need feeding.

lines.zh: 拿开，那点东西不够我一根手指。
lines.en: Take it away; that is less than one finger of mine.

lines.zh: 你用胡萝卜引我，我会连手一起拿。
lines.en: Lure me with a carrot and I take the hand too.

lines.zh: 我的胃口是石头做的。
lines.en: My appetite is made of stone.

lines.zh: 别在我面前晃，晃得我心烦。
lines.en: Stop waving that in front of me; it annoys me.

lines.zh: 诱饵对有力气的东西没用。
lines.en: Bait does nothing to something built of force.

lines.zh: 你想用吃的换命，算盘打错了。
lines.en: Trading food for your life is bad arithmetic.

lines.zh: 我只对会反抗的东西感兴趣。
lines.en: I care only for things that resist.

lines.zh: 你撞我，像雨点撞墙。
lines.en: You hit me like rain hits a wall.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，你自己弹开了。
lines.en: I stood still, and you bounced off yourself.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你的肩膀该脱臼了。
lines.en: That collision should have popped your shoulder.

lines.zh: 别挤，我的位置不是让出来的。
lines.en: Do not push. My place is not given away.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，你最好已经让开。
lines.en: I lift my foot. You had better have moved.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我听见你骨头的声音。
lines.en: The impact let me hear your bones.

lines.zh: 我的重量不跟人商量。
lines.en: My weight does not negotiate.

lines.zh: 你被推出去两格，还算轻。
lines.en: You were shoved two blocks. That was gentle.

lines.zh: 撞完我连气都不用喘。
lines.en: After that collision I do not even need to pant.

lines.zh: 挡在我前面，就是这个下场。
lines.en: Standing in front of me ends exactly like that.

lines.zh: 我这副身子是浇出来的，不是生出来的。
lines.en: This body was cast, not born.

lines.zh: 伴侣？我连同类都很少见。
lines.en: A mate? I rarely even meet my own kind.

lines.zh: 晶体之间只碰，不亲近。
lines.en: Crystals only strike each other, never bond.

lines.zh: 繁殖这种事，跟我没关系。
lines.en: Breeding has nothing to do with me.

lines.zh: 我的力气不传给后代，只砸在地上。
lines.en: My strength passes to no child, only into the ground.

lines.zh: 别问，问了我也不会脸红。
lines.en: Do not ask. I could not blush even if I wanted.

lines.zh: 我的胸口是实心的，装不下这些。
lines.en: My chest is solid; it holds none of that.

lines.zh: 想要温存，去找会喘气的东西。
lines.en: For tenderness, find something that breathes.

lines.zh: 我只会把东西压在一起。
lines.en: I only know how to press things together.

lines.zh: 这类话题，比我脚下的石头还硬。
lines.en: This topic is harder than the stone beneath me.

lines.zh: 这块红晶是从我身上掉的。
lines.en: This red shard fell off me.

lines.zh: 我捡东西只用两根手指，够了。
lines.en: I pick things up with two fingers. Enough.

lines.zh: 你掉的剑，我拿起来看看，太轻。
lines.en: I picked up your dropped sword. Too light.

lines.zh: 我把碎片摞好，摞得比你还高。
lines.en: I stack the shards higher than you.

lines.zh: 弯腰对我是件大事。
lines.en: Bending down is a serious undertaking for me.

lines.zh: 这堆东西，我一只手就能抱走。
lines.en: I can carry this whole pile in one arm.

lines.zh: 别捡那块，它压过我的脚。
lines.en: Leave that piece; it has pressed my foot.

lines.zh: 我拾起石头，顺手就扔了。
lines.en: I pick up stones and toss them away.

lines.zh: 碎片硌手，我不在乎。
lines.en: The shards cut my palm; I do not care.

lines.zh: 我要的不是这些，是能压碎的东西。
lines.en: I do not want these. I want something to crush.

lines.zh: 你，站住，我要用你试力。
lines.en: You. Stand still. I will test my force on you.

lines.zh: 我选目标很慢，选了就不改。
lines.en: I choose slowly, and I do not change.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁味，正好。
lines.en: You smell of iron. Perfect.

lines.zh: 别东张西望，我看的是你。
lines.en: Stop looking around. I mean you.

lines.zh: 这片地方，只有你值得我动手。
lines.en: In this place, only you are worth my effort.

lines.zh: 我的视线落下来，很重。
lines.en: My gaze falls on you, and it is heavy.

lines.zh: 你刚才动了一下，被我看见了。
lines.en: You moved just now. I saw it.

lines.zh: 就算你跑到地平线，我也走得到。
lines.en: Even at the horizon, I can walk there.

lines.zh: 目标确认，红晶开始发热。
lines.en: Target confirmed. The red crystal warms.

lines.zh: 我不追快的，我追挡不住的。
lines.en: I do not chase the fast; I chase the unguarded.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，等下就是我的。
lines.en: What you hold will be mine shortly.

lines.zh: 决定是你了，别让我重复。
lines.en: It is you. Do not make me repeat it.

lines.zh: 我的拳头已经开始发紧了。
lines.en: My fists are already tightening.

lines.zh: 十五点力道，你受得住吗。
lines.en: Fifteen points of force. Can you take it?

lines.zh: 我不绕，我直接走过去。
lines.en: I do not circle. I walk straight there.

lines.zh: 你退一格，我进一步，很公平。
lines.en: You retreat a block; I advance one. Fair.

lines.zh: 你的箭射在我胸口，掉在脚边。
lines.en: Your arrow hit my chest and fell at my feet.

lines.zh: 快到了，我的脚步声比你先到。
lines.en: Almost there. My footsteps arrive before I do.

lines.zh: 别躲在柱子后，那柱子会倒。
lines.en: Do not hide behind that pillar. It will fall.

lines.zh: 你在数我的步子？我步子很大。
lines.en: Counting my steps? My steps are long.

lines.zh: 我一步一步收窄这片地。
lines.en: Step by step, I narrow this ground.

lines.zh: 你的退路，被我踩塌了。
lines.en: Your retreat collapsed under my foot.

lines.zh: 我不用瞄准，我覆盖。
lines.en: I do not aim. I cover.

lines.zh: 红晶簇在我体内发热。
lines.en: Red crystal clusters burn inside me.

lines.zh: 我听见你在喘，就在前面。
lines.en: I hear you gasping, just ahead.

lines.zh: 这片红晶会替我指路。
lines.en: The red crystal will point the way for me.

lines.zh: 你跑得很快，我很慢，但我不停。
lines.en: You run fast, I am slow, but I do not stop.

lines.zh: 最后一格距离，我留给拳头。
lines.en: The last block I save for my fist.

lines.zh: 这一下，地面先塌了。
lines.en: On this blow, the ground gives first.

lines.zh: 我的拳头落下，你的盾成了铁片。
lines.en: My fist falls; your shield becomes sheet metal.

lines.zh: 十五点力气，全在这一击里。
lines.en: Fifteen points of force, all in this strike.

lines.zh: 你飞出去的时候，还很完整。
lines.en: When you flew off, you were still intact.

lines.zh: 我不打第二下，通常不用。
lines.en: I do not strike twice. Usually I do not need to.

lines.zh: 打中你的声音，像敲空桶。
lines.en: Hitting you sounds like striking an empty barrel.

lines.zh: 你退了，血留在原地。
lines.en: You retreated. The blood stayed behind.

lines.zh: 晶簇拳砸下去，地面裂开。
lines.en: My crystal fist falls and the ground splits.

lines.zh: 这一拳，把你按进了土里。
lines.en: This punch pressed you into the soil.

lines.zh: 你的骨头比我想的脆。
lines.en: Your bones are more brittle than I thought.

lines.zh: 我不追打，我一次就够。
lines.en: I do not follow up. One is enough.

lines.zh: 红晶在拳面上碎了一小块。
lines.en: A chip of red crystal broke on my knuckle.

lines.zh: 你还举着剑？勇气可嘉。
lines.en: Still holding that sword? Admirable.

lines.zh: 站稳了，下一拳更重。
lines.en: Stand firm. The next one is heavier.

lines.zh: 我从红色的岩层里被挤出来。
lines.en: I was squeezed out of the red rock layer.

lines.zh: 一落地，我先把脚下踩实。
lines.en: On landing, I first stamp the ground solid.

lines.zh: 这具身体很沉，我喜欢。
lines.en: This body is heavy. I like it.

lines.zh: 又是晶体维度，气味一样。
lines.en: The crystal dimension again, same smell.

lines.zh: 我的第一件事是握拳。
lines.en: My first act is to clench my fist.

lines.zh: 谁把我留在这里，我不问。
lines.en: Who left me here, I do not ask.

lines.zh: 脚下的裂缝是我出生时留下的。
lines.en: The crack under me came from my birth.

lines.zh: 我看见远处有人，正好。
lines.en: I see someone far off. Good.

lines.zh: 力量找到了身体，就住下了。
lines.en: Strength found a body and moved in.

lines.zh: 红晶还在冷却，我已在找人。
lines.en: The red crystal still cools; I am already hunting.

lines.zh: 我一站起来，影子就压了过来。
lines.en: As I rose, my shadow pressed forward.

lines.zh: 这片地要被我重新量一遍。
lines.en: This land will be measured again by my feet.

lines.zh: 别靠近，我还没站稳。
lines.en: Keep back. I have not found my footing.

lines.zh: 出生很吵，落地更吵。
lines.en: Birth was loud. Landing is louder.

lines.zh: 火只在我表面烧，进不去。
lines.en: Fire burns on my surface and goes no deeper.

lines.zh: 摔下来砸了个坑，我很满意。
lines.en: I fell and made a crater. I am pleased.

lines.zh: 水想抬我，抬不动。
lines.en: Water tries to lift me. It cannot.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪推了我半格。
lines.en: The blast pushed me half a block.

lines.zh: 箭卡在红晶里，像根刺。
lines.en: An arrow stuck in red crystal, like a splinter.

lines.zh: 咒语打在我身上，弹回去了。
lines.en: The spell struck me and bounced back.

lines.zh: 我不进食，饿找不到我。
lines.en: I do not feed. Hunger cannot find me.

lines.zh: 雷落在我头上，我替它接地。
lines.en: Lightning hit my head; I grounded it.

lines.zh: 虚空很黑，我的红还在亮。
lines.en: The void is dark; my red still glows.
